## Company Information
Sahara Office Equipment Trading LLC is the leading printer and photocopier rental company in the UAE, serving businesses since 2012. Based in Sharjah, we provide printer rental services across all UAE emirates including Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Al Ain, Fujairah, and RAK.

## Services Offered
- Printer Rental (AED 250/month starting)
- Photocopier Rental
- Printer Repair & Maintenance
- AMC (Annual Maintenance Contracts)
- Toner & Spare Parts Supply
- Printer Sales

## Brands We Service
HP, Canon, Xerox, Brother, Samsung, Lexmark, Kyocera, Ricoh, Sharp, Epson
